title: fagus sylvatica proles tortuosa
intro: Fagus sylvatica proles tortuosa, commonly known as English Beech, is a specific variety of the European beech tree that has twisted and curved branches. The English Beech is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. Therapeutically, it is thought to have a calming effect and may be used to alleviate anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative action. The bioactive constituents of the English Beech include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
